title: Base changes of a smooth curve are smooth of relative dimension $1$
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $C$ be a curve over $k$ [def-pc-curve] (an integral scheme, separated and of finite type over $k$, of dimension $1$) whose structure morphism $C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $T$ be a scheme with a morphism $T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, let $C_T=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}T$ be the base change [def-pc-base-change] and $f_T:C_T\to T$ the second projection. Then $f_T$ is smooth of relative dimension $1$ in the sense of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]: $f_T$ is smooth, and for every point $x\in C_T$, with $t=f_T(x)$ and fibre $(C_T)_t=C_T\times_T\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$, the dimension of $(C_T)_t$ at $x$ [def-kun-dimension] is $\dim_x\bigl((C_T)_t\bigr)=1$.

proof.text: The curve instance [def-pc-curve] gives IsIntegral C, hence IrreducibleSpace C, and IsIntegralCurve.topologicalKrullDim_eq_one gives topologicalKrullDim C = 1. Apply the proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff_topologicalKrullDim_eq f 1 to this equality and the assumed smoothness [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], obtaining SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f. This uses the canonical curve dimension directly, without introducing Scheme.dim or identifying a fibre over Spec k.

It gives SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd f g), the base-changed morphism of [def-pc-base-change]. This preserves smoothness and the dimension simultaneously, and works also when T is empty.
